## What's Changed
* fix: use 0o600 for --remember config files by @skdishansachin in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1187
* fix: harden existing remembered config permissions by @divyanshu-iitian in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1189
* Fix/web receiver silent hang by @NICE-DEV226 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1188
* fix: reject receive paths through symlink parents by @divyanshu-iitian in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1191
* fix: return error instead of panic in EncryptChaCha by @skdishansachin in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1190
* docs: document --exclude-file flag by @sridhar-3009 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1179
* docs: add FlCroc to third-party GUI list by @sridhar-3009 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1180
* build(deps): bump actions/stale from 10 to 11 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1194
* Add encrypted temporary stored transfers by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1196

## New Contributors
* @skdishansachin made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1187
* @NICE-DEV226 made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1188
* @sridhar-3009 made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1179

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/schollz/croc/compare/v10.6.0...v10.7.0
